This section applies if you turn on the optional Enhanced Analytics Add-On (described in Schedule C, which we may update from time to time).

If you turn it on, we collect usage data through it. This applies whether or not we later combine that data with other data or strip out identifying details.

By default, you agree to let us use that data on a non-exclusive basis. If you don't want this, you must object in writing within the time limit stated in Schedule D.

We may change this clause in the future. If you keep using the Service after we change it, that counts as you accepting the change.

We may announce such changes only through your account dashboard. We don't have to email or otherwise contact you directly.
